results.evidence: Exact registry dry-run produced 36 unique primary clusters with one owner each; duplicate-owner fixture fails closed.
CTR source firewall permits only first-party site_gsc or unavailable state; industry benchmark fixture is rejected.
New owner similarity is checked against config.thresholds.similarityMax; duplicate-owner-text fixture is rejected.
Portfolio registry writes require KARAR_DEFTERI evidence and the Phase-01 single writer. Phase 11 performs no registry decision write.
DIVEST pending age evaluator reads config.thresholds.divestPendingMaxDays. No DIVEST recommendation exists in the current partial state.
Any missing score input produces partial:true and null score; partial INVEST is rejected. Current 36/36 clusters are partial.
No first-party position/CTR series is connected, so no striking-distance list is emitted; classifier rejects any future untyped POSITION/CTR row.
Priority formula, confidence policy and config-driven payback rule are explicit; no black-box score is produced.
